create_WerScorer: create a WerScorer instance with a WerScorerConfig to compute word error rate
add_string_WerScorer: add a reference and prediction string pair to the WerScorer for WER calculation
score_WerScorer: compute the word error rate score as a percentage from accumulated string pairs
reset_WerScorer: reset the WerScorer distance and reference length counters to zero
result_string_WerScorer: get a formatted WER result string with the score rounded to two decimal places
